before:
U1103 generates VFORM_DAC_RAW; U1104A buffers it to VFORM_SRC.
U1104B powers the same OPA192 from PROG_P15/PROG_N15 (pins 5/2).
For the low-side write sink, configure FORMING to unipolar 0...+10 V.
Select the DUT voltage sign with MAT_POLARITY, not a bipolar DAC range.
after:
U1103 generates VFORM_DAC_RAW; U1104A buffers it to VFORM_SRC.
U1104B powers the same OPA192 from PROG_P15/PROG_N15 (pins 5/2).
Configure FORMING to unipolar 0...+10 V for the shared CV/CC source.
Select the DUT voltage sign with MAT_POLARITY, not a bipolar DAC range.

before:
The source router chooses among VREAD_SRC, VSET_SRC, VRESET_SRC and
VFORM_SRC. Current-compliance circuitry uses the ILIM outputs; the socket bias
selectors use MATRIX_BIAS_SRC. Setting a DAC voltage alone does not enable a
matrix pulse.
after:
U1601 selects the high-impedance voltage target MAT_VTARGET. The CV/CC
source on sheet 2100 supplies DUT power. SRC also selects matching ILIM: READ
and SET share ILIM_SET; RESET and FORM use their own current DAC outputs.
Changing a service DAC during a WRITE pulse disables RUN and records a fault.

before:
WRITE sources: 0...+10 V only.
Use MAT_POLARITY for the voltage sign across the DUT.
Do not use bipolar FORMING ranges with the low-side current sink.
after:
WRITE sources: 0...+10 V only.
Use MAT_POLARITY for the voltage sign across the DUT.
Voltage targets feed the shared CV/CC source on sheet 2100.
READ shares ILIM_SET; reload current targets with outputs disabled.

before:
U1902 selects TIA, BL service, NL service, buffered CC sense or
buffered ILIM. Codes 5-7 select GND. U1903A/B isolate the raw
compliance nodes from both the trip dividers and monitor-switch
charge. The post-mux buffer on sheet 2000 removes the ADC gain-
network DC load.
after:
U1902 selects TIA, BL service, NL service, buffered current sense or
buffered ILIM. Codes 5-7 select GND. U1903A isolates the INA821
output; U1903B buffers the target for the controller, trip divider and
monitor mux. The sheet 2000 buffer isolates the ADC gain network.

before: U1903: P15 / N15; raw nodes remain in the regulation loop
after: U1903: P15 / N15. Channel B also feeds the source regulator.
